Name: DE-CreditNotes
Statement:
-- +ASSIGNMENTS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.CreditNote)
-- +CUSTOMFIELDS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.CreditNote)
select  doc.Oid,
        doc.Oid as DocumentOid,
        doc.Oid as CreditNoteId,
        doc.Name as CreditNote,
        doc.Name as CreditNoteNumber,
        doc.Date,
        doc.ManagementDate,
        com.Name as Company,
        com.Id as CompanyId,
        com.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        clg.Name as ClientGroup,
        cli.Name as Client,
        cli.Id as ClientId,
        cli.HasImage as ClientHasImage,
        bcl.Name as BillingClient,
        doc.CreatedOnUtc,
        cre.Name as CreatedBy,
        cre.Id as CreatedById,
        cre.HasImage as CreatedByHasImage,
        doc.ModifiedOnUtc,
        mod.Name as ModifiedBy,
        mod.Id as ModifiedById,
        mod.HasImage as ModifiedByHasImage,
        bil.Oid as BillId,
        bil.Name as Bill,
        bil.Number as BillNumber,
        prj.Oid as ProjectId,
        prj.NameAndExternalId as Project,
        cnt.Oid as ContractId,
        cnt.NameAndExternalId as Contract,
        est.Oid as EstimateId,
        est.NumberAndName as Estimate,
        dep.Name as Department,
        cur.Name as Currency,
        cur.IsoCode as CurrencyIsoCode,
        cur.Symbol as CurrencySymbol,
        pcn.Name as PaymentCondition,
        doc.YourReference,
        doc.ValueWithoutVat,
        doc.VatValue,
        doc.ValueWithVat,
        doc.[External],
        doc.ExternalId,
        doc.ExternalError,
        doc.Paid,
        doc.PaidValue,
        wfs.Name as Stage,
        wfs.Color as StageColor,
        wst.Name as StateType,
        wst.Name as StageType
from    ClientCreditNote doc
            join Bill bil on bil.Oid = doc.Bill
            join Client bcl on bcl.Oid = doc.BillingClient
            join ClientLookup cli on cli.Id = doc.CommercialClient
            left join ClientGroup clg on clg.Oid = cli.ClientGroup
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = doc.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
            join UserLookup cre on cre.Id = doc.CreatedBy
            join UserLookup mod on mod.Id = doc.ModifiedBy
            join CompanyLookup com on com.Id = doc.Company
            join Currency cur on cur.Oid = doc.Currency
            join PaymentCondition pcn on pcn.Oid = doc.PaymentCondition
            join DocumentType dt on doc.DocumentType = dt.Oid
            left join UserFavorite uf on uf.DocumentId = doc.Oid and uf.[User] = @CurrentUserId
            left join Project prj on prj.Oid = doc.Project
            left join Contract cnt on cnt.Oid = doc.Contract
            left join Estimate est on est.Oid = doc.Estimate
            left join Department dep on est.Department = dep.Oid
